name: EU VAT compliance change and transition tracker
demand: The European Commission reports that more than 193,000 businesses had registered for the EU’s OSS/IOSS e-commerce VAT schemes by 31 December 2025; this is a broad demand proxy, not a count of multi-country marketplace sellers or buyers for a standalone tracker. The Commission reported more than €38 billion in scheme VAT collected during 2025. [Commission, 3 Sep 2026](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/news/eu-vat-rules-e-commerce-five-years-more-eur125-billion-vat-revenue-2026-09-03_en). ViDA’s published milestones include OSS/IOSS clarifications effective 1 Jan 2027, Single VAT Registration changes from 1 Jul 2028, cross-border B2B digital reporting from 1 Jul 2030, and alignment by 1 Jan 2035. [Commission ViDA timeline](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/taxation/vat/vat-digital-age-vida_en?prefLang=nl). Search-volume data and the target segment’s standalone-monitoring demand are unverified.
prices: Current published examples: hellotax lists €49/month per country for New Seller and €119/month per country for Established Seller; [pricing](https://hellotax.com/pricing?_get=start). SimpleVAT lists software at €25/month Lite and €60/month Pro, and separate filing services including €69/month per country VAT filing; [pricing](https://www.simplevat.eu/pricing/). VATManager lists €0, €12/month Starter and €49/month Pro plans; [pricing](https://vatmanager.eu/en/prezzi/). VatForge lists €0 VAT Radar, €19/month SME Scheme and €79/month OSS Filing; its free tier claims threshold/regime monitoring across all 27 EU countries. [pricing and scope](https://vatforge.com/). These are asking prices for broader products or adjacent monitoring, not evidence of tracker-only sales.
copy_speed: A close product-category competitor launched Fonoa Knowledge on 30 July 2026: Fonoa says it monitors global indirect-tax changes, maps them to a company profile and provides cited insights. [Launch article, 30 Jul 2026](https://www.fonoa.com/resources/blog/introducing-fonoa-knowledge). VatForge says it went live on 1 September 2026 with EU VAT sales-data connections, threshold/regime monitoring and OSS preparation; it targets creators and micro-SaaS, so it is adjacent rather than an exact marketplace-seller tracker. [Product](https://vatforge.com/) and [launch statement](https://vatforge.com/taxdoo-migration-playbook). Fonoa’s enterprise positioning does not prove it serves small sellers, but its feature overlap makes generic regulatory alerts easy to copy.
platform_risk: Shopify Tax already monitors store sales and locations for EU VAT liabilities and sends monthly notifications; it warns that inaccurate VAT registration data can make the information outdated. [Shopify liability monitoring](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/eu/eu-tax-liability). Shopify Tax pricing varies by store creation date and sales threshold; [pricing](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/shopify-tax/pricing). Amazon VAT Services also provides tax-partner registration/filing and says Seller Central can show real-time obligation and deadline updates. [Amazon service](https://globalselling.amazon.com/en/vat). A Shopify app route requires a public app listing, platform review and compliance with Shopify’s app requirements. [Listing visibility](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/distribution/visibility) and [app requirements](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/shopify-app-store/app-store-requirements).
defensible_asset: A dated, source-linked rules database mapped to each merchant’s registrations, marketplace, product categories, sales and inventory could become a maintained rules asset plus switching costs from saved impact history and audit trail; there is no inherent network effect. Public laws and summaries alone are weakly defensible. Fonoa describes source fragmentation, inconsistent formats, multilingual government sources and accuracy/relevance as substantial problems, and says it worked on Knowledge for close to 12 months; that is the vendor’s account of its global product, not an independent build-time benchmark. [Fonoa launch article](https://www.fonoa.com/resources/blog/introducing-fonoa-knowledge).
build_effort: High for reliable production coverage; moderate only if narrowed to EU VAT/ViDA, one merchant segment and one data source. A sellable MVP needs versioned primary-source records, effective dates, reviewed impact mappings, regression checks, merchant-data permissions and support for exceptions. The source and accuracy risks are described by Fonoa [here](https://www.fonoa.com/resources/blog/introducing-fonoa-knowledge). Treat a single-platform MVP as a planning exercise, not a verified time estimate; pan-EU, multi-marketplace coverage is not compatible with assuming agents can safely approve tax interpretations.
channel: Use inbound SEO around dated EU rule changes and seller-specific impact pages, a reviewed public Shopify App Store listing, and contextual paid search. Shopify says a fully visible public listing can appear in App Store search and third-party search results, subject to app requirements. [Visibility](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/distribution/visibility) and [requirements](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/shopify-app-store/app-store-requirements). Keep any email newsletter explicitly opt-in and jurisdiction-checked; UK ICO guidance says marketing email/text to individuals normally requires specific consent and includes social-media direct messages within electronic mail. [ICO](https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/electronic-mail-marketing/?q=gdpr). No cold email, SMS, DM or calls.
owner_hours_per_week: Planning target: 4–5 hours/week after a narrow product is stable, with agents handling monitoring, drafts, matching, notices, onboarding and tier-one support. This is unvalidated; initial rule approval, integration debugging and exception support could exceed the cap. Under a strict 5-hour cap from day one, run only the desk test until actual operating hours demonstrate compliance.
automation_reason: Estimate for all work, not measured: agents can monitor official sources, diff and classify changes, draft source-linked notices, match approved rules to stored merchant profiles, run routine tests, answer common support questions, prepare SEO content and automate billing/admin. Ricardo or a VAT reviewer still needs to approve legal interpretation and impact mappings, resolve edge cases, review security/data access and manage product decisions. The need for sourced, accurate tax outputs is highlighted by [Fonoa](https://www.fonoa.com/resources/blog/introducing-fonoa-knowledge).
moat_assessment: Conditional rules-engine moat: pursue only the merchant-specific impact graph and dated evidence trail, not a generic VAT-news feed. Fonoa’s 2026 launch overlaps regulatory intelligence and company-profile relevance; VatForge and Shopify already overlap sales-data monitoring or liability alerts. A narrow marketplace/SKU/inventory mapping may differentiate, but the asset is not yet demonstrated and needs expert review to be defensible. [Fonoa](https://www.fonoa.com/resources/blog/introducing-fonoa-knowledge), [VatForge](https://vatforge.com/), [Shopify](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/eu/eu-tax-liability).
desk_test: One-day, no-outbound test: use the Commission’s ViDA materials to create three clickable, source-cited impact cards for constructed seller profiles (for example, EU marketplace goods, non-EU IOSS goods, and digital B2C sales), then publish a one-page beta offer with a clearly labeled test price and paid-reservation option. Check high-intent search terms and existing Shopify App Store results that day. Treat only a paid reservation or comparably strong purchase action as willingness-to-pay evidence; waitlist signups alone are not proof. [ViDA timeline](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/taxation/vat/vat-digital-age-vida_en?prefLang=nl), [Shopify listing discovery](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/distribution/visibility).
red_flags: No verified revenue, paid-customer cohort or dated payment event for this proposed product was found; published competitor rate cards are not revenue proof. The €193,000+ OSS/IOSS population is not the same as its addressable marketplace-seller subset. For ordinary marketplace goods sellers, the Commission’s 2027 milestone is described as OSS/IOSS clarifications plus an e-charging extension; the 2028 deemed-supplier measures concern short-term accommodation and road passenger transport, while 2030 digital reporting concerns cross-border B2B. That weakens a broad near-term urgency claim for typical B2C goods sellers. [Commission timeline](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/taxation/vat/vat-digital-age-vida_en?prefLang=nl). Free or bundled adjacent monitors and the July 2026 Fonoa launch make standalone-monitoring willingness-to-pay unverified. [VatForge pricing](https://vatforge.com/), [Shopify monitoring](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/eu/eu-tax-liability), [Fonoa launch](https://www.fonoa.com/resources/blog/introducing-fonoa-knowledge).
